shard.name: Roundcube Webmail
shard.description: Leading open-source browser-based multilingual IMAP webmail client with a desktop-like user interface, address book, spell checking, and rich MIME support.
shard.author: The Roundcube Team & Midnight Team

variables.name: IMAP Server Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the incoming IMAP server (e.g. ssl://imap.example.com or 127.0.0.1).

variables.name: IMAP Server Port
variables.description: Port of the IMAP server (e.g. 993 for SSL/TLS, 143 for STARTTLS).

variables.name: Outgoing SMTP Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the outgoing SMTP server (e.g. ssl://smtp.example.com or 127.0.0.1).

variables.name: Outgoing SMTP Port
variables.description: Port of the SMTP server (e.g. 465 for SSL, 587 for STARTTLS, or 1025 for local testing).

variables.name: Product Name
variables.description: Title displayed on the webmail login screen and browser tab.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Arguments passed to the PHP built-in server.
